status: PROPOSED: Level 1 and Level 2 test selection for a builder's own feedback loop. It is NOT wired into the governed gate, never marks a requirement verified, and never replaces Level 3 (the full governed gate at every slice merge, as frozen).
projectSelection: A changed file selects its own project and every project and test project that references it, transitively. Each selected test project is run in full.

rules.reason: contracts, pins, project files and governance change what every test means
the GitHub adapter and the save and load machines: real-provider integration tests
event shapes, replay and the storage codec: fixture replay (T15) and catalog load (EXT-DATA-011/013, T25)
screens, field identifiers and journeys: browser tests and requirement-to-field traceability
shared presentation (global stylesheet, Forma, shell) reaches every screen

failSafe: A path that no ownership entry and no rule recognises selects ALL. A deleted or renamed path is a changed path.
never: A requirement is never verified because its tests were not selected.
Selection never skips the governed gate: every slice merge still runs the full plan (Level 3).
